reply:
`git stash` defaults to tracked changes only. Untracked files stay in the working tree unless you use `-u` (or `--include-untracked`). The `-a` flag adds ignored files too.

Your new file wasn't stashed because it was untracked. Use `git stash -u` next time to include it.
